insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: 2 Lacs to 6 Crores (Base Sum Insured options listed); Sum Insured may include Base Sum Insured + Super Reload + Super Credit (+ Cancer Booster if opted)

great.name: Room Rent: No limit (At actuals) up to Sum Insured
great.quote: Room Rent: Actuals up to Sum Insured
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One MAX+)
great.explanation: No room category restriction/capping in the product benefit table, so you can choose any room (subject to Sum Insured). This helps avoid room-rent linked deductions.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization: 90 days
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... for up to 90 days immediately prior to the date of such Hospitalization.
great.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for 90 days before hospitalization (for the same condition and linked to an admissible hospitalization).

great.name: Built-in additional Sum Insured buffer: Super Reload (unlimited refills)
great.quote: We shall provide for a reload amounting to the Base Sum Insured ("super Reload"), unlimited times during the Policy Year
great.explanation: If your Base SI (and accumulated Super Credit, if any) is exhausted/insufficient, the insurer reloads up to Base SI unlimited times in the year (conditions apply, including applicability from the 2nd claim in policy life per benefit table).

great.name: NCB / Renewal Bonus (non-resetting): Super Credit increases irrespective of claims
great.quote: Super Credit (Increases Irrespective of Claim): 100% of Base Sum Insured per year, up to 500% of Base Sum Insured (up to Max of 3 Cr under this benefit)
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One MAX+)
great.explanation: This is a strong renewal bonus because it grows even if you claim (i.e., it is non-resetting as described in the table). Exact caps depend on the schedule/benefit table.

great.name: Consumables / Non-medical items: Covered if Claim Protect is applicable
great.quote: Non-payable items will be covered (all 4 lists of Annexure I)
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One MAX+); also Section C.4 Claim Protect (Non-Medical Expense Waiver)
great.explanation: If Claim Protect is applicable/in force for you (as per policy schedule), non-medical consumables listed in Annexure I (all lists) are covered—reducing common out-of-pocket items like gloves, masks, syringes etc.

great.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization: Covered
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Medical Expenses incurred during the Policy Period on Domiciliary Hospitalization of the Insured Person
great.explanation: Home-based treatment is covered when it would normally require hospitalization and meets conditions (including minimum 3 consecutive days).

great.name: Bariatric surgery: Covered (subject to conditions)
great.quote: Obesity Treatment: Medical Expenses incurred towards treatment... arising out of Hospitalization for a Bariatric Surgery during the Policy Period subject to the conditions that needs to be fulfilled as per Section D.1.6
great.explanation: Bariatric surgery is covered if it meets the specified medical criteria in the obesity exclusion/conditions.

great.name: Modern treatments/procedures: Covered at actuals up to Sum Insured (listed procedures)
great.quote: Modern Procedures / Treatments: Actuals up to Sum Insured for listed procedures
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One MAX+)
great.explanation: Modern procedures are covered without a separate rupee sub-limit in the benefit table (for listed procedures), subject to overall Sum Insured.

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days (non-accident)
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Standard 30-day initial waiting period for illnesses (accidents covered).

good.name: Specific illness/procedure waiting period: 24 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries / treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.reference: Section D.1.2 Specified disease / procedure Waiting Period (Code-Excl02)
good.explanation: Standard 2-year waiting for listed specific conditions/procedures (e.g., cataract, hernia, piles, etc.).

good.name: Optional cover trade-off: PPN discount with co-pay outside PPN hospitals
good.quote: Preferred Provider Network (PPN) Discount... discount of 10%... If the Insured Person takes treatment... other than those listed as “Preferred Provider Network”, then... shall bear a Co-Payment of 10% on each and every claim
good.reference: Section C.15.5 Preferred Provider Network (PPN) Discount
good.explanation: Not a default restriction—this applies only if you opt for the 10% discount optional cover.

bad.name: Restore Benefit: Not found (assumed not covered)
bad.quote: Not mentioned in the provided text.
bad.reference: Document extract provided (no explicit Restore/Restore+ benefit clause found)
bad.explanation: No restore benefit identified in this extract. If absent, Sum Insured is NOT replenished after a claim (separately from Super Reload, which is a different refill mechanism). Please confirm from the policy schedule/benefit table for your exact variant.

bad.name: Post-hospitalization: 180 days (not >180 days)
bad.quote: for up to 180 days from the date of discharge from the Hospital.
bad.explanation: Coverage is limited to 180 days post-hospitalization; this is good, but not best-in-class (>180 days).

unclear.name: Co-pay (default/base plan): Not explicitly stated (except via optional PPN cover)
unclear.quote: Co-Payment: means a cost sharing requirement... (definition provided).
unclear.reference: Section B.1.10 Co-Payment (definition); Section C.15.5 shows co-pay only under optional cover
unclear.explanation: This extract defines co-payment and mentions a 10% co-pay only if you opt for the PPN Discount optional cover. It does not clearly state whether the base policy has any mandatory co-pay (e.g., for certain ages/claims). Verify in your Policy Schedule.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
